visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two adult men sit at a dark wooden table in a brightly lit studio environment. The man on the left, wearing a black pleated long-sleeve shirt, holds a black-cased smartphone and points at its screen with his right index finger. The man on the right, in an olive green t-shirt, leans toward the phone with a focused facial expression. A silver laptop is open between them. The background features a large yellow sofa and metallic shelving with awards. (2) An inset vertical video appears showing a woman with long dark hair and red lipstick speaking. Then, the view returns to the studio where the man in the black shirt gestures with his hands to explain a concept while the other man listens intently. (3) The scene cuts to a clip of Taylor Swift speaking in a dimly lit room, followed by a montage of several men in different casual indoor settings, each recorded on a phone camera. Back in the studio, the host in black continues his animated explanation with frequent hand gestures. (4) A close-up shot shows two vintage mobile phones with physical buttons resting on a flat surface. The video then transitions back to the studio where the host gestures expansively. Clips of a young girl and a woman with curly hair holding blue smartphones are briefly shown as examples. (5) A vertical video of a woman demonstrating a handheld camera shake effect is displayed. In the studio, the two men react, with the man in the olive shirt smiling and nodding. (6) A promotional segment begins with a graphic overlay for 'LEXUS MY FILM'. The man in the black shirt holds up his phone while speaking directly to the viewer. Split screens show multiple creators in various outdoor and indoor locations. The video concludes with a wide shot of the two men laughing together at the wooden table.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 欸關節. (2) [Subtitle]: 會讓人發現你是老人！. (3) [Subtitle]: 蛤？. (4) [Subtitle]: 最近看到一個名詞叫.... (5) [Slogan]: Millennial Pause (千禧世代的停頓). (6) [Subtitle]: 講說90年代出生的人每次拍影片之前都會先.... (7) [Subtitle]: 停頓幾秒，才開始講話. (8) [Subtitle]: 就連泰勒絲也會這樣！. (9) [Subtitle]: 然後就被Z世代的人嘲笑說是老人的象徵. (10) [Slogan]: Millennial Pause. (11) [Subtitle]: 欸真的會欸，為什麼會這樣？. (12) [Subtitle]: 有些人認為原因是我們長大的時候還沒有智慧型手機嘛. (13) [Subtitle]: 所以錄影器材也比較不穩定. (14) [Subtitle]: 加上我們看到鏡頭都會覺得要進入正式模式. (15) [Subtitle]: 所以下意識會停頓一下，確認全部東西都準備好才開始. (16) [Subtitle]: 啊Z世代都不會嗎？. (17) [Subtitle]: 欸比例還真的比較少！你看. (18) [Subtitle]: 大家推測是因為Z世代對鏡頭更加習慣. (19) [Subtitle]: 而且後來智慧型手機鏡頭基本上也不太有問題. (20) [Subtitle]: 所以他們都是一拿起來直接開錄. (21) [Subtitle]: 啊不過取而代之的是他們有所謂的.... (22) [Slogan]: THE "GEN Z SHAKE". (23) [Subtitle]: 在開場的時候會這樣晃一下，更加隨性自然的感覺！. (24) [Subtitle]: 怎麼辦？我們這種老人臭是不應該再拍短影片了？. (25) [Subtitle]: 我覺得光是討論怎樣的東西很老人，就蠻老人力. (26) [Subtitle]: 不會啦，我覺得短影片的精髓就是展現自己的特色！. (27) [Logo]: LEXUS MY FILM 短影音生活影展. (28) [Slogan]: 我的價值 我主張. (29) [Subtitle]: 像是最近 LEXUS MY FILM 短影音生活影展在開放報名. (30) [Subtitle]: 不管你是Z世代還是停頓老人，只要願意拿起手機來拍. (31) [Subtitle]: 就有機會贏得總共35萬的獎金. (32) [Subtitle]: 還有機會跟我、奇軒、金魚腦一起交流共創影片喔！. (33) [Subtitle]: 快搜尋 LEXUS MY FILM 官網一起來看看吧！. (34) [Subtitle]: 啊你們拍影片會抖一下嗎？
